facts.fact: The guide recommends setting a modest daily budget of $10-20 for Google Ads (Search) during months 4-6 of the first year.
The guide suggests launching a first CTV campaign with $50-100 in months 4-6.
The guide's minimum viable first-year marketing budget is $300-500 per month.
The guide's growth-focused first-year marketing budget is $1,000-2,000 per month.
The guide's aggressive growth first-year marketing budget is $3,000-5,000 per month.
In months 7-9 the guide recommends shifting 70% of budget to top-performing channels and keeping 30% for testing.
facts.quote: Shift 70% of budget to your top-performing channels. Keep 30% for continued testing and new experiments.

facts.fact: The guide recommends giving each marketing channel at least 60-90 days before judging performance.
facts.quote: Give each channel at least 60-90 days before judging performance.

facts.fact: The guide lists 20-50+ positive Google reviews as a realistic first-year success benchmark.
The guide lists 500-1,000+ email subscribers as a realistic first-year success benchmark.
The guide recommends that during months 1-3 spending focus on foundational elements such as website and basic tools rather than advertising.
facts.quote: Focus spending on foundational elements (website, basic tools) rather than advertising.

facts.fact: The guide recommends allocating $100-200 per month to Google Ads in the minimum viable budget.
New businesses typically need to invest 12 to 20 percent of projected revenue in marketing, more than established businesses, according to AdWave's guidance.
facts.quote: New businesses often need to invest more heavily in marketing than established ones, typically 12 to 20 percent of projected revenue.

facts.fact: AdWave advises new businesses to start with one or two marketing channels, learn what works, and then expand.
facts.quote: Start with one or two channels, learn what works, then expand.

facts.fact: AdWave advises new businesses to begin paid advertising only after validating that the product or service resonates with customers and they can handle increased demand, while starting free and low-cost marketing immediately.
facts.quote: Begin paid advertising once you've validated that your product or service resonates with customers and you can handle increased demand.
